citation: Chicago Daily Tribune, 15 April 1883, classified 'To rent': '1729 and 1731 Indiana-av., 2-story, basement, and mansard-roof frame'.
author: Chicago Daily Tribune
locator: The 'To rent' column: 'TO RENT—1729 AND 1731 INDIANA-av., 2-story, basement, and mansard-roof frame'.
rights_note: A US newspaper published in 1883, in the public domain. Read for a description.
access_notes: Found 2026-10-24 (T-3068) through the Internet Archive's full-text search for "1731 Indiana". Tribune 'To rent' notices put furnished rooms at 1735 Indiana, 'corner Eighteenth-st.', from 1888 to 1893.
note: Three years before Robinson's plate: the north house on 1727-1737 was a two-storey frame house over a basement under a mansard, let as two numbers.
what_it_supplies: the north frame house's storeys and roof: two storeys over a basement, a mansard
